name: Sayonara C.C Summer Days
original_name: さよなら C.C Summer Days
source:
Setting is a small provincial town.
Siblings are good friends.
The sister has been physically weak since childhood.
The brother became a doctor for that reason.

"I'll surely become a doctor to heal you."

This is the siblings' 17th summer.

[summary translated from the [url=http://yooglesyndicate.com/game/Goodbye_C.C_Summer_Days/GB_CC_Summer_Days.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一座地方小镇。
兄妹二人感情融洽。
妹妹自幼体弱多病。
哥哥也因此成为了一名医生。

“我一定会成为医生，治好你的病。”

这是兄妹二人的第十七个夏天。

[summary translated from the [url=http://yooglesyndicate.com/game/Goodbye_C.C_Summer_Days/GB_CC_Summer_Days.html]official website[/url]]
